_comment: Map legend: # wall, . floor, + closed door, $ treasure chest, > stairs down, @ party start. Letters are monster spawns defined in 'legend'. Every row must be the same length. Edit freely and refresh the browser! 'chest_items': each entry rolls independently per chest — 'chance' 0.5 means half of chests hold that item (ids from items.json) alongside the gold. 'chest_random': every chest also holds this many items drawn at random from the whole of items.json (great for testing; set 0 or remove for none). 'rest_ambush': chance (0-1) that making camp on this level is interrupted by wandering monsters from the legend — the party wakes half-healed and fighting.
name: The Vermin Warrens
